CustomField.description: API name of a CSS static resource to load only for this Form Template. It is applied in addition to the org-wide Form_Style_Sheet__mdt overrides; author its CSS against the template container class (the Form Template record Id is emitted as a class on the form container) so it scopes to this template. Plain text — the static resource name.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Enter the name of a CSS static resource to load for just this template's forms. Leave it blank for none, and scope your rules to the template's container (the record Id is added as a CSS class) so they don't affect other forms on the same page.
CustomField.label: Style Sheet
